ip: IP is the sciences concerned with gathering, manipulating, storing, retrieving, and classifying recorded information.
IP means the same as information science or informatics or information processing.
ipecac: An ipecac is a medicinal drug used to evoke vomiting.
iphigenia: Iphigenia is the daughter of Clytemnestra and Agamemnon.
ipidae: Ipidae is large family of bark-boring or wood-boring short-beaked beetles.
Ipidae means the same as Scolytidae or family Scolytidae or family Ipidae.
ipo: IPO is a corporation's first offer to sell stock to the public.
IPO means the same as initial public offering or initial offering.
ipod: IPod is a pocket-sized device used to play music files.
ipomoea: Ipomoea means the same as genus Ipomoea.
ipomoea alba: Ipomoea alba is pantropical climber having white fragrant nocturnal flowers.
Ipomoea alba means the same as moonflower or belle de nuit.
ipomoea batatas: Ipomoea batatas is pantropical vine widely cultivated in several varieties for its large sweet tuberous root with orange flesh.
Ipomoea batatas means the same as sweet potato or sweet potato vine.
ipomoea coccinea: Ipomoea coccinea is annual herb having scarlet flowers.
Ipomoea coccinea means the same as red morning-glory or star ipomoea.
ipomoea fastigiata: Ipomoea fastigiata is tropical American prostrate or climbing herbaceous perennial having an enormous starchy root.
Ipomoea fastigiata means the same as wild potato vine or wild sweet potato vine or man-of-the-earth.
ipomoea imperialis: Ipomoea imperialis is hybrid from Ipomoea nil.
Ipomoea imperialis means the same as imperial Japanese morning glory.
ipomoea leptophylla: Ipomoea leptophylla is a morning glory with long roots of western United States.
Ipomoea leptophylla means the same as man-of-the-earth.
ipomoea nil: Ipomoea nil is annual Old World tropical climbing herb distinguished by wide color range and frilled or double flowers.
Ipomoea nil means the same as Japanese morning glory.
ipomoea orizabensis: Ipomoea orizabensis is tropical American morning glory.
Ipomoea orizabensis means the same as scammony.
ipomoea panurata: Ipomoea panurata is tropical American prostrate or climbing herbaceous perennial having an enormous starchy root.
Ipomoea panurata means the same as wild potato vine or wild sweet potato vine or man-of-the-earth.
ipomoea pes-caprae: Ipomoea pes-caprae is a prostrate perennial of coastal sand dunes Florida to Texas.
Ipomoea pes-caprae means the same as railroad vine or beach morning glory.
ipomoea purpurea: Ipomoea purpurea is pantropical annual climbing herb with funnel-shaped blue, purple, pink or white flowers.
Ipomoea purpurea means the same as common morning glory.
ipomoea quamoclit: Ipomoea quamoclit is tropical American annual climber having red flowers and finely dissected leaves.
Ipomoea quamoclit means the same as cypress vine or star-glory or Indian pink.
ipomoea tricolor: Ipomoea tricolor is annual or perennial climbing herb of Central America having sky-blue flowers.
Ipomoea tricolor means the same as common morning glory.
ipratropium bromide: An ipratropium bromide is an inhaled bronchodilator.
Ipratropium bromide means the same as Atrovent.
iproclozide: An iproclozide is an antidepressant drug that acts as a monoamine oxidase inhibitor.
ipse dixit: An ipse dixit is an unsupported dogmatic assertion.
Ipse dixit means the same as ipsedixitism.
ipsedixitism: An ipsedixitism is an unsupported dogmatic assertion.
Ipsedixitism means the same as ipse dixit.
ipsus: Ipsus is a battle between the successors of Alexander the Great.
Ipsus means the same as battle of Ipsus.
ipv: IPV is a poliovirus vaccine consisting of inactivated polio virus that is injected subcutaneously to provide immunity to poliomyelitis.
IPV means the same as Salk vaccine.
ipsilateral: Ipsilateral means on or relating to the same side.
ipso facto: Ipso facto means by the fact itself.
For example: "Ipso facto, her innocence was established."
